decision_basis: Both fixed normal instances completed; TLC and independent exact BFS counts and action coverage agree; the changed-release counterexample was independently replayed; source and limited S8-prefix mappings and final independent internal reviews support the stated scope.

freeze.preservation_scope_note: Review-time author workspace preservation before subsequent manuscript integration. A standalone S10 archive does not reverify all external baseline targets.

negative_result.partial_count_reason: TLC detects the violating successor on generation; exact BFS checks on queue removal.
negative_result.interpretation: Effect 1 precedes unsafe release while its result is unreconciled; local accounting and quota remain valid, but effect backing and then the external effect bound fail. This is a changed abstract rule, not an observed complete-client failure or exact replay of Figure 1.

s8_correspondence.missing_subset_interpretation: Static expiry from the saved unexpired-effect state and archived prefix support the limited correspondence; no complete state-set export or all-checkpoint membership test was performed.

resources.gc_recommendation_retained: -XX:+UseParallelGC was recommended in TLC logs and was not added to the historical run.
resources.timing_scope_note: TLC host wrapper wall time and exact search-loop time have different scopes.

limitations: Only two fixed finite instances; no cutoff theorem, unbounded theorem or proof of all concrete histories.
Fixed legal immutable payloads and stable identities; no full O1/O2 semantics, parsing, evidence qualification or claim/fallback verification.
Atomic durable client/sink transitions, truthful ACKs and persistent per-operation deduplication are modeled mechanisms/assumptions.
Message-presence channels coalesce duplicates; expiry is a per-operation monotone abstraction; no network liveness or deadline guarantee.
No policy revision migration/revocation, received-but-unissued cleanup, arbitrary low-level release, post-arm cancellation or compensation.
No Python/SQLite refinement, power-loss/corruption proof, multi-node implementation guarantee, or malicious-trusted-component/bypass coverage.
No CPU work or S9 computation-before-result-persistence interval; no exactly-once CPU or monetary bound.
Both complete clients map to the same abstraction; no ECRC superiority or new algorithm claim.
recommended_manuscript_scope: A short S10 methods/result addition, one explicit limitation and supplementary tables/trace. Retain the existing conditional argument and implementation experiments as distinct evidence.
document_generation_scope: Derived reporting only; no model rerun, frozen-source mutation, manuscript edit, packaging or publication performed by this documentation task.
